resolutions.title: 'substantive decisions' threshold undefined
resolutions.action: Added 'Definition of substantive decision' scenario with heuristics (resolves named alternatives / locks name-structure-format / supersedes earlier choice; excludes exploratory thinking)

resolutions.title: marker classification heuristics rely on AI judgment
resolutions.action: Added 'Classification heuristics' scenario with ordered rules: stale (from pushback) → trivial (single-line, obvious) → decision required (ambiguity/design/scope) → unresolvable (missing info)

resolutions.title: external-review prompt not specified as literal template
resolutions.action: Added 'Reference prompt template' scenario with the full prompt structure embedded; added 'Output-format block must be verbatim' scenario to prevent parsing breakage

resolutions.title: pushback discipline procedure not algorithmically detailed
resolutions.action: Added 'Pushback decision procedure' scenario with 6-step algorithm (identify symbol → grep → git log -S → read file → compare → report evidence)

resolutions.title: tasks don't back-reference specific requirement IDs
resolutions.action: Added a convention header to tasks.md describing the [R<#> in <capability>] annotation format and the operational-vs-spec-tied distinction; annotations to be added incrementally as implementation lands

resolutions.title: D1 distribution model not encoded as spec requirement
resolutions.action: Added 'Distribution model — overlay, not CLI fork' requirement with two scenarios (overlay shape, consumers install after openspec init)

resolutions.title: D2 naming taxonomy implicit only
resolutions.action: Added 'Verb-prefix naming taxonomy preserved' requirement with two scenarios (verb categories, new verb requires justification)

resolutions.title: some tasks not tied to spec requirements
resolutions.action: Marked Groups 1, 11, and 12 as '(operational)' to distinguish delivery work from spec-tied behavior implementation; convention header documents the distinction

resolutions.title: 'heavy' vs 'light' enforcement boundary undefined
resolutions.action: Added 'Light vs heavy enforcement boundary' scenario with concrete examples (light = grep + spot-checks; heavy = full AST + exhaustive walk — latter is the linter's job)

resolutions.title: Pass 6 Gap Hunt success criterion tautological
resolutions.action: Added 'Pass 6 Gap Hunt operational heuristic' scenario with four concrete checks per requirement (unstated assumptions, error paths, state transitions, two-implementer agreement)

resolutions.title: README on .orbit-runs/ committed status could be more explicit
resolutions.action: Rewrote the .orbit-runs/ subsection: 'Committed to the repo, not gitignored' with rationale (iteration record is real evidence; supports team handoffs; dot-prefix signals 'orbit metadata, not part of canonical openspec change')

resolutions.title: 'structured claims' extraction undocumented
resolutions.action: Added 'Structured claim extraction' scenario in Category 3 with four claim categories (named entities, quantitative claims, architectural assertions, rules/conventions referenced in non-convention docs)

final_assessment: All 12 findings resolved. Change is ready for /opsx:apply.
